title: Wax ci ngelaw li
intro: Xalaatal barab bu li ñuy gis ak li ñuy gis booloo, nga taxaw ci kanamu nit ku nekk ci biir réew mu wuute ak yeneen yi. Ruuh gi amna xam-xam bu ëpp li nit ñi mëna am, di doxal doole yu ñeneen ñi mënul xalaat. Waaye, mbindéef bu ndaw mën na toroxal ki gëna am doole, te dëgg gi mën na nekk lu nëbbu ba jamono jiñ ko jàpp. Kan mooy nit ku legatam wéy di am ci jamono yi?
clues: Dañu ma jox nguur gu kenn du am ci sama ginaaw.
Sama waajur buma bëgg lool moo ma jëlee xam-xam ak xel mu ñaw.
Ngelaw li mingi woon ci sama ndigal, di dem fépp fu ma bëggee.
Mënoon naa dégg picc yi di wax, te dañu nekkoon ci sama larme.
Dama jot xibaar bu jóge ci picc mu ndaw, lu jëm ci benn reine bu jaamu jant bi.
Sama dee nekk na lu nëbbu ba mbindéef ci kaw suuf lekk sama baat, ci noonu la jinne yi xamee ni xamu ñu lu nëbbu.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
